Executive Officer Job at GoldenHeart Teaching Hospital




        
    

        
        GoldenHeart Teaching Hospital, Abeokuta (Proposed) is a modern, patient-centred healthcare institution committed to excellence in clinical care, training, research, innovation and community service.

We invite applications from suitably qualified candidates for the position below:

 Job Position: Executive Officer

Job Location: Abeokuta-Sagamu Expressway, Ogun

Requirements


	Minimum qualification: OND / HND qualification.
	Added advantage:  Bachelor's Degree.


General Requirements:
     

            
    




	Excellent communication and Interpersonal skills
	Demonstrate integrity, professionalism and leadership
	Be proficient in computer applications relevant to your discipline
	Be willing to contribute to the development of a world-class College of Nursing Sciences.


Why Join Us?


	State-of-the-art Facilities.
	Career Growth Opportunities.
	Professional Development.
	Competitive Remuneration.
	Conducive Work Environment.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Applications to: [email protected] and copy: [email protected] using the Job Title as the subject of the mail.
Or
Submit Hardcopies of the Applications to the School at: 
Off Abeokuta-Sagamu Expressway,
Moloko, Ashipa, Abeokuta,
Obafemi Owode Local Govt Area,
Ogun State.

Applications / Documents Required


	Application Letter.
	Detailed Curriculum Vitae.
	Copies of Academic and Professional Certificates.
	Current Practising Licence (where applicable).
	Three (3) Referees' Report.
	Evidence of previous employment and relevant experience.


Note


	Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
	Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
	GoldenHeart Teaching Hospital reserves the right to accept or reject any application without assigning any reason.
	For more enquiries, contact: 08068288238 (WhatsApp Only) or call: 07055661300.

Product Marketing Manager Job at Roqqu




        
    

        
        Roqqu is a leading indigenously owned cryptocurrency exchange in Nigeria. Our platform offers various services including buying, selling, swapping, sending, and receiving Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies, as well as quick crypto to naira withdrawals.

Roqqu is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity in the workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Product Marketing Manager

Job Location: Chevron Alternative Route, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a Product Marketing Manager to develop and execute marketing strategies that drive product awareness, customer acquisition, engagement, and adoption.
	The successful candidate will collaborate with internal stakeholders to develop and execute go-to-market initiatives, ensuring our products are effectively positioned in the market and resonate with our target audience.
	The role requires a strategic and commercially minded professional with strong product marketing experience, exceptional communication skills, and the ability to translate complex product features into compelling customer value propositions.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for new and existing products.
	Define product positioning, messaging, and value propositions for different customer segments.
	Develop product launch plans and coordinate cross-functional execution.
	Gather customer feedback and collaborate with Product teams to enhance product offerings and customer experience.
	Track product and campaign performance using analytics tools and provide actionable insights to support business decisions.
	Identify emerging market trends and recommend strategies to strengthen product positioning and market competitiveness.
	Create compelling product messaging and marketing content that clearly communicates product features, benefits, and differentiators.
	Partner closely with relevant stakeholders to ensure successful product launches and marketing campaigns.
	Analyse campaign performance and recommend improvements to optimise customer acquisition, engagement, and product adoption.
	Stay updated on industry trends, fintech innovations, cryptocurrency, blockchain, and emerging marketing technologies.


Requirements
Qualifications:


	Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Economics, or a related field.
	3-5 years of proven experience in Product Marketing, Marketing, Brand Management, Product Management, or a similar role, preferably within fintech or technology.
	Strong understanding of product positioning, go-to-market strategy, and product lifecycle management.
	Experience in fintech, crypto, or financial services strongly preferred.
	Proficiency in analytics tools (Google Analytics, etc.).
	Demonstrated experience driving measurable growth outcomes.


Key Competencies:


	Strong analytical and data interpretation skills.
	Performance-driven mindset.
	Excellent communication and storytelling ability.
	Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
	Strategic thinking with hands-on execution capability.
	Adaptability in a highly regulated and evolving industry.


Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
